answer_1.quote: News summarization is the task of automatically converting news articles into concise summaries that correctly convey the main information of the articles.

answer_2.quote: We use BS-Precision and Attribution to evaluate factual consistency.

answer_4.quote: We also conducted a human annotation, focused on three aspects: (i) factual consistency where the summary has no factual errors and all the details in the summary are supported by the article, (ii) informativeness where the summary express the main points of the article and the summary content is important and relevant, and (iii) coherence where the summary has good structure and flow, is easy to follow, and facts in the summary are presented in logical order.
answer_4.guideline: Human annotators rated summaries on factual consistency (categorizing errors), informativeness (using 1-5 stars for main points), and coherence (using 1-5 stars for structure and flow), with explanations required for imperfect ratings.
